note: What a server sends to lock the camera to the champion or free it. A client answers with CameraLock, except while playing a replay, and ignores the message while something of its own holds the camera. The header carries zero.

fields.name: locked
fields.note: Nonzero to lock the camera, zero to free it; a client tests the whole byte, so any set bit locks it.

revisions.note: A client answers at once with CameraLock, returning the state byte as it arrived. While the game holds a forced lock, it keeps the byte and sends it only as that lock lifts.
